name: Toki
source:
"This is in a demon's nature."

A demon who awakened after sleeping for a thousand years. He has no hesitation in killing and was once feared by both humans and youkai. His actions are straightforward with his emotions, but he is not good at expressing them in words.

Maybe it's because he's a confident man, but he can't help but wonder why Kuro doesn't want to become his.

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_toki.png]official website[/url]]

One of Kuro's love interests.
